programme.title: Nabídka studia
programme.degree: Bc., full-time (Prezenční); programme code B0613A140036; specialisations Počítačové vědy (B0613A140036S01) and Výpočetní technika
programme.how_found: www.zcu.cz/en -> Bachelor's and master's programmes -> Study Fields (JavaScript filter, no links) -> faculty www.fav.zcu.cz/en/Admission/Bachelor-studies/ ('Computer Science and Engineering' = department KIV) -> www.kiv.zcu.cz/cs/Education/ -> 'INFORMATIKA' (redirects to the zcu.cz catalogue entry FieldNumber=B0613A140036).
programme.notes: The English catalogue URL (www.zcu.cz/en/Admission/Study-fields/...B0613A140036...) renders an empty shell without the programme, so no twin is recorded. The catalogue entry leaves 'Jazyk výuky' blank; the language comes from the faculty page. Departmental description: https://www.kiv.zcu.cz/cs/Education/bc-inf.html (title 'Informatika'). Other KIV bachelors (Softwarové inženýrství, Informační systémy) are not the CS programme.

english.quote: The study in bachelor's and master's degree programmes is offered only in the Czech language.
english.notes: Czech-only; foreign applicants (except Slovaks) must prove a minimum Czech level per CEFR ('details are given in the instructions for the selected type of study', not read).

gpa.notes: Admission conditions are published only for 2026/2027 and only as collapsed sections on https://www.fav.zcu.cz/cs/Admission/Bachelor-studies/Admission-procedure/2026-2027/admission-condition.html (FAV EN page mentions criteria such as national comparative exam results); no threshold read.

deadline.notes: Only the 2026/2027 cycle is published: 'Termín pro podání přihlášek do 2. kola přijímacího řízení je 7.8.2026' (https://www.fav.zcu.cz/cs/Admission/Bachelor-studies/Admission-procedure/2026-2027/); the 2027-2028 page does not exist yet (404). Single round for all applicants.

tuition.notes: Czech-taught study at a public university carries no tuition; no ZČU page quoting this was found within the time box.

scholarship_exists.quote: O přidělení prospěchového stipendia rozhoduje děkan, podmínky jsou uvedeny v příslušné vyhlášce.
scholarship_exists.notes: FAV merit scholarship paid monthly for 10 months, amount by dean's decree and depending on the previous year's study average (VSP); for enrolled students, competitive. FAV also lists extraordinary, mobility, accommodation and social scholarships.

scholarship_international.notes: No citizenship condition stated on the FAV scholarship pages.
